title: Recombinant Human Interferon a-2b Gel for HPV-16 and/ or HPV-18 Gynecological Infections
brief_summary: to assess the efficacy and safety of recombinant human interferon α-2b gel (Yallaferon®) for the treatment of patients with cervical HPV-16 and/or HPV-18 infections; to analyze the HPV type infections and clinical negative conversion.
condition: Cervical HPV-16 and / or HPV-18 Infection
